title: Vegan Dominican Potato Salad with Ugly/Rescued Produce (Ensalada Rusa)
summary: In this Goodful tutorial, Chef Yadi (Happy Healthy Latina) veganizes a Dominican favorite, ensalada rusa, using rescued or “ugly” produce from Misfit Market. The video walks through prepping potatoes, carrots, beets, onions, and peas, replacing eggs with vegan mayo, and building a vibrant, plant-based version of the traditional salad. Key techniques include marinating onions in apple cider vinegar, coloring with beets, boiling vegetables in salted water with careful color control, and a playful “pump and dump” method to blend everything together. A guest (Guillermo) samples the finished salad, illustrating how a culturally rooted dish can be adapted for vegan and waste-reducing cooking while preserving flavor and celebration-worthy appeal.
topics: Onion marination in apple cider vinegar
Potato and carrot prep for salads
Beet handling and separate-pot technique to avoid color bleed
Use of peas in the salad
Adobo seasoning for salt and flavor
Salted boiling water and bite-sized pieces
Mise en place and scrap bowl

sections.title: Intro and dish concept
sections.description: Host introduces the idea of veganizing the Dominican potato salad and explains the appeal of using rescued produce, setting the stage for a colorful, plant-based version.

sections.title: Ingredients and rescued produce
sections.description: Shows the lineup of ingredients, highlighting rescued produce and the traditional components that will be veganized.

sections.title: Prep and trimming
sections.description: Describes trimming and prep steps, saving tops and scraps for later use, and starting the color preparation flow.

sections.title: Onion prep and marination
sections.description: Dices onions and marinates them in apple cider vinegar to add a tangy note to the salad.

sections.title: Boiling and mixing prep
sections.description: Boils potatoes, carrots, and beets (beets in a separate pot to avoid pink bleed); cuts everything into bite-sized pieces for mixing.

sections.title: Dressing, mixing, and tasting
sections.description: Assembles the salad with vegan mayo, seasons it (salt, pepper, adobo), uses a center-to-out mixing approach, and finishes with a guest tasting.
